intro.name: Jan Tokic
intro.bio: I build AI products end to end, and the infrastructure under them. Most recently at starc., where I designed, built and owned the entire AI side of an investing app now live on the App Store. Before that, two years at Vendure, the open-source commerce platform, building enterprise B2B systems for its largest customers.

starc.description: First engineering hire. Designed, built and owned the entire AI side: a market-moments engine over price data and news for 2,000+ assets, RAG over live market data, and the eval harness. Live on the App Store, 10,000+ insights generated.

vendure.description: Open-source commerce platform (8k GitHub stars), formerly ALPIN11 / Elevantiq. Built enterprise B2B systems on Vendure for Flowtech, Feddersen and Stocker: multi-tenant white-label shops and a rules-based chimney configurator. Plugins and features for the core, dashboard and enterprise suite.

mira.description: Solana trading bot in Go. Real-time signal pipeline, 8,000+ automated trades/month at sub-300ms execution, 99.5% uptime. Led a remote team of 3.

copile.description: 2,100 users. €1.2M monthly volume. 70% retention. Built the trading tools, led the team.

ibm.description: Built a storefront handling 85,000 products. Cut promotion launch time by 40%.

starc-investing-platform.title: starc.
starc-investing-platform.shortDescription: AI-native investing app. First engineering hire, owned the entire AI side. Live on the App Store.
starc-investing-platform.fullDescription: AI-native investing app by NextGen Wealth Labs (Berlin) that gives new investors context, not commands. I joined as the first engineering hire and designed, built and owned the entire AI side: a market-moments engine that scans price data and news, detects significant moves and attributes a cause at macro, sector and asset level across 2,000+ assets; RAG and personalisation over live market data so every explanation is grounded in the user's own portfolio; and the evaluation harness that regression-tests agent output across prompt and model changes. Anthropic and Gemini models via Vertex AI, served on GCP and Cloudflare. I also carried a large share of product and DevOps work.
challenges: Detect market moments across 2,000+ assets and attribute a cause at macro, sector and asset level
Ground every explanation in the user's live portfolio and market data
Regression-test non-deterministic agent output across prompt and model changes
outcomes: Entire AI side designed and shipped by one engineer in six months

vendure-ecommerce.title: Vendure
vendure-ecommerce.shortDescription: Open-source commerce platform (8k GitHub stars). Enterprise B2B systems for Flowtech, Feddersen and Stocker.
vendure-ecommerce.fullDescription: Software engineer at Vendure from April 2024 to March 2026, joining through ALPIN11 / Elevantiq, the agency that owned and later merged into Vendure GmbH, on a team of about seven. Built enterprise B2B commerce on Vendure for its largest customers: multi-tenant white-label shops for Flowtech Fluidpower (UK hydraulics distributor, migrated off a legacy enterprise platform) and the Feddersen Group (8+ tenants), and a rules-based chimney configurator for Stocker Kaminsysteme, built solo in about five months: hundreds of sizing rules over thousands of parts synced from Pimcore, generating orders directly in Vendure. For Stocker I also consolidated the legacy codebases into one monorepo, upgraded every dependency and moved hosting to Docker Swarm. Contributed plugins, dashboard features and fixes to the Vendure core and enterprise suite alongside the founders.
challenges: Multi-tenant, white-label B2B shops with tenant-specific catalogues and pricing
Configurator: hundreds of sizing rules over thousands of Pimcore parts, orders straight into Vendure
Legacy codebases into one monorepo, dependency upgrades and Docker Swarm hosting without downtime
outcomes: Flowtech off its legacy platform, total cost of ownership halved (Vendure case study)
Stocker configurator shipped solo in about five months
Plugins and features merged into Vendure core, dashboard and enterprise suite

chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.title: chtype - Type-Safe ClickHouse Toolkit
chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.shortDescription: Type-safe ClickHouse toolkit for TypeScript — schema codegen, query builder, and enhanced client.
chtype-clickhouse-toolkit.fullDescription: TypeScript toolkit that introspects your ClickHouse schema and generates fully typed code. Includes a type-safe query builder with ClickHouse-specific functions (argMax, FINAL, PREWHERE), an enhanced client wrapping @clickhouse/client, and a CLI for schema diffing. Zero runtime overhead — prevents SQL injection by design and catches column typos at compile time.
challenges: Type-safe codegen from live ClickHouse schemas
ClickHouse-specific query builder with PREWHERE, argMax, FINAL
Schema diffing CLI to detect database drift
